notes:
Account snapshot: CultureSync is a Europe-headquartered CX platform powering multilingual contact centers for retail and fintech verticals. They operate ~150 enterprise customers; running conversational automation across voice+chat. Main ask: robust multilingual agent-assist + automated ticket summaries with locale-aware tone (formal vs. informal). Need deterministic behavior under holiday spikes (Nov–Dec) and strict EU data residency.

Recent timeline / activity (short bullets):
- 2025-11-05: initial discovery w/ Marcus L (AE) + Riley (SE). high-level demo of Redwood hosted API; customer emphasized tone/localization.
- 2025-11-16: deep-dive w/ engineering (Riley) — integration points (CTI, CRM) and tool-calling requirements logged (Drive: redwood-infra-eval-v1).
- 2025-12-10: POC kickoff — 7-day POC to run translations + agent assist on 10 languages (DE, FR, ES-LATAM, PT-BR, NL, IT, PL, SV, RU, EN).
- 2026-01-08: POC bench results: baseline hosted inference meets quality; however peak latency at 2.8k concurrent sessions exceeded target during synthetic spike tests. SE recommended dedicated pools + prefix KV cache. (See FF-20260214-0892 call notes).
- 2026-02-14: Security questionnaire submitted; customer requested SOC2/ISO-27001 attestation and KMS integration details. Legal indicated data residency clauses must be explicit.
- 2026-02-21: Pricing deck shared (drive link), initial Dedicated quote provided; internal procurement loop started.

Use-case / requirements (crisp):
- Workloads: real-time agent-assist (chat/voice), end-of-conversation ticket summarization, automated tool-calls to CRM and order systems, on-the-fly translation for non-English sessions.
- Scale: currently ~50k daily conversations; peak concurrency ~3k active sessions in EU during promotions; expect 2–3x growth during Black Friday.
- Latency: target end-to-end token latency <= 200ms for agent-assist in top-3 languages (DE/EN/FR); soft target <= 300ms for others.
- Throughput: need sustained throughput of ~120k tokens/minute during peak windows; burst tolerance for 5–10 minute spikes.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate-high — prefer predictable cost for enterprise customers but will pay premium for guaranteed SLOs and data residency.
- Model preferences: open-model variants with quantization options; lighter fallback models for cold-start languages; explicit tone-control conditioning (formal German, friendly LATAM Spanish).
- Routing/fallback: regional routing mandatory (serve EU sessions from EU region); automatic fallback chain (primary high-quality model -> quantized variant -> low-cost model) with telemetry for quality regression.

Technical notes / integration points:
- Integration: CTI vendor is Twilio Flex; CRM is Salesforce (tool-calls must write to case fields and add agent notes).
- Auth: SSO/SAML for admin console; scoped API keys for service-to-service.
- Observability: needs per-route latency and token cost breakdown; token-level tracing desired for production incidents.

Quotes / customer color:
- "German answers need to be formal for banking accounts — don’t make them 'too friendly'." — Head of Support (Anna Müller)
- "If we can't keep latency stable under promotional spikes we lose CSAT and SLA credits — reliability is non-negotiable." — CTO (M. Alvarez)

Risks / blockers (short):
- Security package (SOC2 docs) required before procurement kickoff.
- Legal needs explicit data processing addendum covering EU residency and subprocessors.
- Quantization/regression risk: customer wants quality-preserving quantization profile documented.

Next steps (actionable):
- Schedule Dedicated capacity pricing + SLO packaging call (AE + SE + Procurement) — target week of 2026-03-10.
- Run focused latency mitigation POC: test autoscaling + prefix KV caching under synthetic holiday spike (SE action item).
- Provide SOC2/ISO artifacts and KMS integration notes to legal (drive doc shared).
- Deliver sample tone-control prompts and evals for DE/ES-LATAM to demonstrate locale-aware outputs.

CRM notes style: shorthand, action-focused. POC artifacts and support tickets linked above.
